author.description: Who is credited: an account, a name with no account behind it, or a group or event, which is how a branch puts a motion forward. Exactly one of `did`, `display` and `context` is present, as `kind` says.

did.description: A DID, or the id of an account carried over from the interim that nobody has signed in as yet.

context.description: The space of the group or event.

binned.description: In the bin: hidden from every view, and restorable until purged.

root.description: The record whose removal took this one along. A restore undoes that one act and not a guess at a subtree.

number.description: A number that atproto data cannot hold, inside `content` or `data`: a fraction, or an integer past 2^53 - 1. In its own digits, as JSON writes a number.
